qa_pairs.question: How do the legal authorities for issuing a notification under the Customs Act evolve across the provided SROs, and how does this relate to the legislative framework established by the Third Schedule?
qa_pairs.answer: The legal authority for issuing a notification has transitioned from Section 19(1) of the Customs Act, 1969, as seen in SRO No. 210-আইন/২০২২/১১৮/কাস্টমস [2], to Section 25(1) of the Customs Act, 2023, as seen in SRO No. 219-আইন/২০২৫/৪১/কাস্টমস [0] and SRO No. 224-আইন/২০২৫/৪৬/কাস্টমস [1]. While the Third Schedule serves as the anchor for subordinate legislation under Section 219 of the 1969 Act, the current notifications [0, 1] exercise regulatory power directly through the 2023 Act in consultation with the NBR to amend previous notifications.
